New decision "Retire twining_handoff/twining_acknowledge at v3; v2.1 deprecates them and reorients all plugin guidance to the committed-doc + artifact-pointer handoff pattern" relates to:
- 01KJJ3KQG24Y0365NBFWXX129W: "Fix Stop hook to return required JSON decision format for Claude Code validation"
- 01KJJAZEHG6HTT11SY8GSPM6VX: "Stop hook uses line-number comparison for per-commit Twining coverage instead of session-wide counts"
- 01KKBXHKFZHNT41AF3RQHF47GN: "Enforce mandatory agent registration and handoff in plugin v1.1.5"
- 01KMT252V9HT9PQZRENV368S0Q: "Add SessionStart command hook to inject Twining Lifecycle Gates into project CLAUDE.md"
- 01KQV9EHAWVCAENCYJKYYG8YZ9: "Placed the new session-start-context.sh"
- 01KQWCCVX48E3NFJ5NVCJXZKGS: "Used node -e for JSON parsing in the hook"
- 01KWK9KV209JRSW70E32MYYDCX: "All hook gates are sentinel-based and fail open when unsatisfiable — no transcript grepping anywhere, and a fresh clone or dead server never blocks commits or session exit"
- 01KY07QJ8D8WXQ7575QJ8GQ4GN: "Chose plugin minor bump 1.11.3 → 1.12.0 for the pin change"
- 01KY1J1N5974PR5Q55SHGTJNQ2: "Chose to satisfy the per-item audit-trail criterion by adding an optional reasons map (id → rationale) to twining_archive_stale rather than packing per-item text into the existing single reason string"
